Class AbstractChipParameterRenderer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<Object>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractChipParameterRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<Object>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ResourceUUIDParameterRenderer, UriParameterRenderer
public abstract class AbstractChipParameterRenderer extends AbstractParameterRenderer<Object>
Common abstract base class for chip/pill parameter renderers (e.g. URIs, Paths, Resource UUIDs).

Manages the dual-mode CardLayout lifecycle:

  • Compact Pill View: High-density pill featuring Copy, Name Label (click-to-edit), Open in IDE, Edit, and Delete actions.
  • In-Place Editor View: Dynamically expands across the container width hosting the native AbstractTextResourceViewer with syntax highlighting, line numbers, Cancel, and Save actions.
Author:
anahata
